ValidationRule.description: Allows only system users and users with the "Account - Reassign" or "Account - Reassign Hierarchy Restriction" permission to change Account Owner https://app.asana.com/0/1198916935095389/1206569274136037/f
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), RecordType.Name = "Customer Account", NOT( OR( $Permission.Account_Reassign, $Permission.Admin_Automation_Exclusion, CONTAINS($User.Full_Name__c , 'Traction'), AND( $Permission.Account_Reassign_Hierarchy_Restriction, NOT( $Permission.Account_Reassign_SMB_Restricted) ), AND( $Permission.Account_Reassign_SMB_Restricted, Hierarchy_Segment__c = 'SMB' ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to change account ownership. If you think this is incorrect, please contact RevOps for assistance.
